param: B Constant influx (recruitment) rate of human hosts into susceptible class
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
ρ Probability exposed hosts progress to symptomatic infectious class (primary infection)
σ Reinfection intensity factor for asymptomatic hosts (distinguishes primary vs secondary infection contact intensity)
βₕ(a) Age-specific transmission/contact rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans
k(a) Age-specific progression rate from exposed to infectious (inverse of latent period)
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans (symptomatic and asymptomatic) to susceptible mosquitoes
Nₕ(t) Total human population size at time t (used to normalize standard incidence)
